host_population.definition: source addresses inside a network scope declared monitored
host_population.fallback: with no declarations the legacy behaviour applies (every address is in scope) and the report says so; it is never reported as full coverage

sources.name: flows
sources.accepted_missingness: every monitored host must be observed in the window; a host with no flows is not observed, not quiet

sources.name: flows_aggregated
sources.accepted_missingness: the temporal, change-point and challenger families read this table; an absent row is not a zero score

sources.name: zeek_conn
sources.accepted_missingness: a few hosts may be silent; measured 22/22 monitored hosts on 2026-11-12

sources.name: zeek_dns
sources.accepted_missingness: hosts that do not resolve names are legitimately absent; measured 21/22 on 2026-11-12

sources.name: zeek_ssl
sources.accepted_missingness: hosts that never initiate TLS are legitimately absent; measured 19/22 on 2026-11-12

sources.name: zeek_notice
sources.accepted_missingness: opportunistic: a notice is emitted only when Zeek raises one, so absence is normal and is never read as zero
